environment.gc: enabled; collected before each measured batch
environment.io: warm OS page cache; no fsync; final buffer drain included
environment.memory: fresh-process Linux RSS, including native allocations

attribution.profile_caveat: Instrumented timings are attribution, not SDK latency.
attribution.stage_caveat: Isolated operations, not additive pipeline timings; fixed timestamp and scalar objects; no writer in native_ingest/native_publish.

comparison.scope: 100 scalar metrics; five paired rounds per workload; 20000 measured calls, or 3000 for immediate flush; plus 100 warmup
comparison.runtime_changes: None during this investigation; extension unchanged from native-optimized.json
comparison.validation: Every field of every persisted row, sequential steps, final summary/series, no drops, and backend commit count; outside timing/RSS sampling
comparison.changing_payload: 1024 precomputed dictionaries cycling each call; generation outside timing; included in RSS; warmup indexes -100 through -1
comparison.numpy_type: numpy.float64 only, not all NumPy dtypes
comparison.backend: counting no-op backend; no network latency
comparison.profile_payload: reused constant dict; paired SDK workers additionally call dict(payload)
